## Summary

- **New `src/lib/core/http-resilience.ts`** — typed, testable HTTP resilience primitives: `fetchWithTimeout`, `fetchWithRetry`, and `isAbortError`
- **Timeouts on all outbound `fetch()` calls** — 60 s for chat completions, 120 s for image generation and wig try-on; AbortController-based so Vercel functions never hang indefinitely on a stalled API
- **Exponential-backoff retry on transient errors** — provider adapter retries up to 3× on HTTP 429/5xx or AbortError, with ±20% jitter and Retry-After header support (capped at 30 s)
- **Bug fix: status-code inversion in `image-generation-pipeline.ts`** — `isConfigError` was checking `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR` instead of `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR`, returning 503 for client-side validation failures and 502 for missing env vars; now reversed correctly

## What changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/core/http-resilience.ts` | New — `fetchWithTimeout`, `fetchWithRetry`, `isAbortError` |
| `src/lib/adapters/provider-adapter.adapter.ts` | Chat: `fetchWithRetry(fetchWithTimeout(..., 60s), 3×)`; Image: same with 120 s |
| `src/lib/adapters/image-generation-seam/index.ts` | `fetchWithTimeout(..., 120s)` with AbortError → `IMAGE_NETWORK_ERROR` |
| `src/lib/adapters/wig-try-on-seam/index.ts` | `fetchWithTimeout(..., 120s)` with AbortError → `WIG_TRY_ON_NETWORK_ERROR` |
| `src/lib/core/image-generation-pipeline.ts` | Fix: `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR` → `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR` in `isConfigError` check |
| `tests/unit/http-resilience.test.ts` | New — 17 tests covering timeout, retry, jitter, Retry-After, and abort handling |
| `tests/unit/image-generation-pipeline.test.ts` | 2 new tests asserting correct 503/502 for config vs. validation errors |

## Test plan

- [x] `npx vitest run` — 400 tests pass, 1 skipped (unchanged integration skip), 0 errors
- [x] `npm run check` — 0 svelte-check errors, 0 TypeScript warnings
- [x] New `http-resilience.test.ts` covers: fast success, timeout abort, timer cleanup, retry on 429/503, non-retry on 400/401, AbortError retry, Retry-After header, 30 s cap
- [x] Bug fix covered by two new pipeline tests asserting `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR → 503` and `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR → 502`

Add shared HTTP resilience utilities and apply them to outbound provider and seam requests while correcting image pipeline error handling.

New Features:
- Introduce http-resilience primitives providing fetch timeouts and exponential-backoff retry with jitter and Retry-After support.
- Apply configurable timeouts to chat, image generation, and wig try-on outbound HTTP requests, mapping timeouts to specific network error codes.

Bug Fixes:
- Correct image generation pipeline status mapping so IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR yields 503 and IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR yields 502.

Enhancements:
- Add retry logic for provider adapter chat and image requests on transient HTTP errors and timeouts, capping retries and backoff delays.

Tests:
- Add unit tests for HTTP resilience covering timeout behavior, retry policy, jitter, and Retry-After handling.
- Extend image generation pipeline tests to assert correct HTTP status codes for config versus validation errors.

It also fixes an error-code check in the image generation pipeline so config vs. validation errors map to the intended HTTP statuses. **Changes:** - Added `src/lib/core/http-resilience.ts` with `fetchWithTimeout`, `fetchWithRetry`, and `isAbortError` primitives. - Applied timeouts (and retries for provider adapter calls) across provider, image-generation, and wig-try-on adapters. - Fixed `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR` vs `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR` status mapping in `runImageGenerationPipeline`, and added unit coverage for the status behavior. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a centralized HTTP resilience module in `src/lib/core/http-resilience.ts`, providing utilities for request timeouts and exponential backoff retries with jitter. These improvements are integrated into the image generation, provider, and wig try-on adapters to handle stalled APIs and transient network errors more effectively. Additionally, the image generation pipeline was updated to refine error status mapping, and comprehensive unit tests were added for the new resilience logic. Feedback was provided to improve `fetchWithTimeout` by allowing it to compose an externally provided `AbortSignal` with the internal timeout signal using `AbortSignal.any()`.

Keep the timeout timer and clear it in finally, and ensure you pass controller.signal to fetch (so the controller can be aborted either by the timeout or by the upstream init.signal).
